Each promotion is turned into the real discount you get for the number of items you have to buy. Under 15% scores nothing, 20% scores very little and half price scores full marks. That is multiplied by how much the aisle matters for a weekly shop: meat, fish, bread, fruit and vegetables count most, drinks and sweets about half, alcohol, baby and pet products least. Having to buy several items costs a little, and saving more euros earns a little. A promotion covering many products takes one place, and no aisle takes more than three.
